title: Biomarkers of Efficacy and Tolerability of Sacituzumab-Govitecan in the Treatment of Patients With Triple-negative Breast Cancer in the Metastatic Phase: Prospective Multicenter Real-world Study
official: Biomarkers of Efficacy and Tolerability of Sacituzumab-Govitecan in the Treatment of Patients With Triple-negative Breast Cancer in the Metastatic Phase: Prospective Multicenter Real-world Study
summary: Observational, prospective, multicenter study. Collection of data relating to the effectiveness of sacituzumab govitecan SG, in a real-world context and planned research of predictive biomarkers of efficacy/tolerability carried out on multiple platforms at the center coordinator.
